mybelovedumcdesert:description: A very specific source for one very specific van.
mybelovedumcdesert:welcome: Word is the UMC Desert is still roadworthy. Call me when you want one of your own.
mybelovedumcdesert:dialog_start: I kept the paperwork warm. Pick a color and the UMC Desert is yours.
mybelovedumcdesert:dialog_missing_vehicl: I cannot find the UMC Desert in this game build. The old vehicle type may have changed.
mybelovedumcdesert:dialog_no_spawn: I cannot find a safe place to hand over the keys right now.
mybelovedumcdesert:dialog_purchased_play: I will take the UMC Desert.
mybelovedumcdesert:dialog_purchased_mana: She's all yours. Treat her nicely.
